name: prism3
description: Prism3 monorepo — the token generation engine and the surfaces (theme studio, Figma plugin) that render from its shared contracts. The engine core stays buildless (run via tsx); the adapters bundle it.
// scripts: The repo's first root scripts (#789). `verify` is the gate runner — the same list ci.yml runs, in an order it declares and checks, with a per-gate PASS/FAIL table. Read verify.ts's header before changing it: the four things it exists to get right (status captured with no pipeline between, output buffered per gate, ordering declared and enforced, and a gate that did not run never printed as a pass) are each a defect that has actually shipped here.
